current_events: The Israel Defense Forces announce that Al-Qassam Brigades commander Muhammad Bassam Mushtaha, who was accused of taking hostages during and after the Hamas–led attacks against Israel on October 7, was killed in a recent airstrike last month in northern Gaza
Heavy fighting erupts in El Obeid, North Kordofan, Sudan, between the Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces. Clashes also break out in Um Arada
American missionary Kevin Rideout is released from captivity after being kidnapped by an unidentified organisation front in Niger nine months prior
A Mw 4.8 earthquake strikes the province of Granada in Spain, with damage reported in Granada and the surrounding area and being felt in Madrid. (El Mundo (in Spanish))
A Mw 7.7 earthquake struck off the coast of the island of Flores in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia
Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York for the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson
In road bicycle racing, the eighth stage at the Volta a Portugal race is neutralised after British cyclist Finlay Tarling was killed in an accident during the race
